profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software developer with experience in both the web and application world.

Specialties: Software development, IT services

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Spring Boot · Object Oriented Design · Scrum · Computer Science · Microservices · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop .NET and other web applications both for internal and external purposes.  Drupal development for websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Object Oriented Design · Scrum · Computer Science · Microservices · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET MVC · Problem Solving

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop C# programs and T-SQL queries for those programs that dealt with reporting and other tasks involved with a large SQL database. The relational database is used to all of the information needed to collect money from debtors.  One such program involved sending debtor payment information to a merchant account and updating the database as required.  Design and develop new tables for that database for data-warehousing-type tasks. Upkeep the internal website used for requesting reports, filling out forms when debtors are going to pay, and handle collectors* teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Object Oriented Design · Computer Science · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving

positions.title: Interactive Project Specialist
positions.description: Developed websites for clients, perform Search Engine Optimization tasks; is an official site for the Lexus of Las Vegas Open, part of the USTA circuit.  Shuttlelasvegas.com is a site where travelers can purchase shuttle vouchers for McCarran Airport.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Handled client calls, updated websites, performed Search Engine Optimization tasks for clients that                 included creating content for blogs, link building, etc.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Tested and debugged Dangerous Waters, a naval combat simulation computer game developed by Sonalysts.  This included fixing and solving bugs related to upgrading the code to work with a new version of the   C++ complier. Developed a satellite trainer for the United States Air Force using C#, XAML, and WPF.  This was a desktop application for Windows XP that allowed simulations to be run of what would really happen as a satellite operator. Obtained Top Secret clearance

positions.title: Intern Consultant- Programmer
positions.description: Developed a web application using Java for Spring MVC, JavaScript, HTML, JSTL, and CSS.  Site; Specific tasks included using AJAX and other tools to allow messaging between stylists on the site.

positions.title: Co-op Programmer
positions.description: Developed security programs during the summer of 2007. Assisted in the reorganization of data involving assets of multiple companies in Europe. Assisted in configuration and installation of computer hardware and software for redistribution to companies within Connecticut
